title: Follow the optional download helper
description: You inspect the archive branch and its recorded exception message.

steps.description: You import archive and path tools, then try to load Colab's files helper. The try block covers the later archive and download calls too.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. Otherwise, the code prints a missing-folder message.

steps.question: What happens if files.download raises an exception?
steps.answer: The except block catches it and prints the helper-unavailable message with the exception text.

steps.description: You see that fallback message in the recording. It states that google.colab.files.download is unavailable in code-viz.
